title: H1 Exclusive Stage Timing
objective: Define and validate mutually exclusive end-to-end stage timing receipts for the authentic h=1 prepared class-group root without running qualification timing

oracles: Exact contiguous interval partition and cross-multiplied per-call gap identity

handoff.summary: Defined an instrumentation-ready single-active-stage wall-clock timer and strict diagnostic receipt for the authentic h=1 prepared root. Every arm retains contiguous root-relative segments in four named stages plus an explicit residual; validation proves those segments are positive, gap-free, nonoverlapping, cover the root exactly, and reproduce the claimed totals. Per-pair Sage.js-minus-PARI gaps use exact cross multiplication despite unequal repetition counts, and the five stage gaps must sum exactly to the root gap. The attributed-gap fraction is the predeclared median of positive-root-gap pair fractions, with faster stages unable to cancel an unexplained positive residual. Seven alternating synthetic pairs and eleven negative cases pass; no real timing was run.
risks: The timer is ready for adapters but is not yet inserted at the four authentic Sage.js/PARI stage transitions; this lane intentionally performs no benchmark.

The diagnostic schema fixes qualified timing to false. The final runner must embed validated diagnostics into the existing pinned-core, quiet-host, locked qualification protocol rather than relabel these receipts.
next_steps: Add one integration adapter per implementation that switches the same timer at the four source-corresponding stage boundaries and emits matched digests.
After the authentic root and artifacts are frozen, run at least seven alternating AB/BA diagnostic pairs on the approved quiet Linux host.
Copy the validated median attributed-gap fraction into the prepared-kernel qualification receipt only after checking provenance and matched outputs.
